item.title: Quit Social Media
item.description:
Some Notes from “Quit Social Media” by Dr. Cal Newport @ TedxTyson

Cal is not on social media.

He claims that he’s been more successful than ever without social media. My goal is to investigate why.

Debunking Common Objections

1. Social Media is one of the most important technologies in the 21st century. Rejecting it would be an act of extreme Luddism.

That’s pure nonsense. It is not a fundamental technology, but they leverage off a fundamental technology (think of it as slot machines). It’s pure (unsavoury) entertainment, and nothing more.

item.title: Some Reflections About the Article "A Forty Year Career" by Will Larson, and what has changed since 2019
item.description:
The American Dream (What happened to it?)

I really believe that every person can attain success, prosperity and social advancement, despite its birthplace, family status etc. I’ve really interiorised this concept and I still dream about a word in which I can express myself at best. I still don’t know where my career is heading, if it’s financial independence or personal success or another thing.

My parents are pretty “adults”, and they will continue working for at least 10 years (shame on SPNI), and while I am still trying to find the motivation to finish my CS degree (which I am not lacking because of my love for Computer Science, which is stronger than ever, but because of issues with my University that are “unlikely to be resolved”), I am also harshly looking for some things to do for a living.
